findings.title: MQTT disconnect code 7 — connection lost
findings.detail: 7 disconnect(s) from the cloud broker with code 7 (connection lost, libmosquitto numbering).
findings.fix: Check WAN stability, NAT/firewall idle timeouts and broker keepalive; correlate with network-monitor drops.

playbook.cause: 2 of 7 drops coincide with the controller losing its own network (local/WAN outage). The others had no local alarm — most often a router/firewall dropping the long-lived TLS connection or a short ISP blip.
steps: Check the site WAN/Internet link at these times (ISP outage, router reboot, Wi-Fi/cellular backup failover).
Look for firewall/NAT idle timeouts shorter than the MQTT keepalive on outbound 443 to messaging.*.hanwhavision.cloud.
If the network was healthy, collect the bundle and the broker host/time and escalate as a broker-side disconnect.
